title: Process attempts to clear a Windows event log
description: Detects wevtutil or PowerShell attempting to clear a Windows event log. Process telemetry shows the command attempt and does not prove that the log was cleared.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may clear Windows event logs to remove investigation evidence.
hypothesis.rationale: MITRE documents event-log clearing through wevtutil and PowerShell as indicator blocking, while administrators may use the same commands during approved maintenance or image preparation.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify explicit wevtutil clear-log and PowerShell Clear-EventLog commands while leaving log queries, exports and unrelated PowerShell commands unmatched.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process events

triage.summary: Determine which log was targeted, who launched the command and whether the action belongs to an approved administrative workflow.
steps: Review the complete command, target log, parent process, account, device and nearby process activity.
Confirm whether maintenance, image preparation, testing or troubleshooting authorized the clearing operation.
Preserve remaining telemetry and inspect for defense tampering, credential access or destructive activity before and after the command.
false_positives: Approved image preparation, laboratory resets, log maintenance and troubleshooting

validation.expected_outcome: Match explicit wevtutil and PowerShell log-clearing attempts; do not claim success and do not match log query, export or unrelated PowerShell activity.
